# golang — 2020 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 25 golang CVEs of 2020 are in `data/cve/vendors/golang/2020.jsonl`.

### CVE-2020-29509
- Assigner: Mattermost | Published: 2020-12-14 | Updated: 2024-09-17 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-115 CWE-115 Misinterpretation of Input
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

The encoding/xml package in Go (all versions) does not correctly preserve the semantics of attribute namespace prefixes during tokenization round-trips, which allows an attacker to craft inputs that behave in conflicting ways during different stages of processing in affected downstream applications.

**workarounds:** Untrusted markup in affected applications can be validated using the github.com/mattermost/xml-roundtrip-validator module.

Affected:
- Golang / Go: affected All versions

References:
- https://github.com/mattermost/xml-roundtrip-validator/blob/master/advisories/unstable-attributes.md [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20210129-0006/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2020-29510
- Assigner: Mattermost | Published: 2020-12-14 | Updated: 2024-09-16 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-115 CWE-115 Misinterpretation of Input
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

The encoding/xml package in Go versions 1.15 and earlier does not correctly preserve the semantics of directives during tokenization round-trips, which allows an attacker to craft inputs that behave in conflicting ways during different stages of processing in affected downstream applications.

**workarounds:** Untrusted markup in affected applications can be validated using the github.com/mattermost/xml-roundtrip-validator module.

Affected:
- Golang / Go: affected unspecified <=1.15 (custom)

References:
- https://github.com/mattermost/xml-roundtrip-validator/blob/master/advisories/unstable-directives.md [x_refsource_MISC]
- https://security.netapp.com/advisory/ntap-20210129-0006/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2020-36559 — Path Traversal in aahframe.work
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE 23: Relative Path Traversal
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Due to improper sanitization of user input, HTTPEngine.Handle allows for directory traversal, allowing an attacker to read files outside of the target directory that the server has permission to read.

Affected:
- aahframe.work / aahframe.work: affected 0 <0.12.4 (semver)

Credits: @snyff

References:

- https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2020-0033
